OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector.

SPYCLOUD_API_BASE_URL.description: SpyCloud API base URL (a trailing slash is added if missing).

SPYCLOUD_SEVERITY_LEVELS.description: Comma-separated list of severities to filter breach records (allowed values are 2, 5, 20, 25). Leave empty to import all severities.

SPYCLOUD_WATCHLIST_TYPES.description: Comma-separated list of watchlist types to filter breach records (allowed values are 'email', 'domain', 'subdomain', 'ip'). Leave empty to import all watchlist types.

SPYCLOUD_TLP_LEVEL.description: TLP level to set on imported entities.

SPYCLOUD_IMPORT_START_DATE.description: The date to start importing breach records from, used only if the connector's state is not set. Can be either absolute (ISO 8601 date, e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z') or relative (ISO 8601 duration, e.g. 'P30D' for 30 days ago).
